title: PracticePay Patient Financing Fee, Waiver and Delinquency Schedule
content:
PracticePay Patient Financing charges the same late and returned-payment fee figures on every plan; the plans differ only in how many courtesy waivers a plan may receive in any rolling 12 months.

## Figures common to every plan

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Grace period after a monthly due date before a late fee may be assessed on a monthly payment still unpaid | 10 calendar days |
| Late fee per monthly payment missed | 27.00 USD, never more than the unpaid part of that monthly payment |
| Most late fees for one monthly due date | 1 |
| Fee per returned payment | 15.00 USD |
| Return codes that carry a returned-payment fee | R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16, R20 |
| Window to request a courtesy waiver | 45 calendar days after the fee's assessment date |
| Delinquency reported to the credit bureaus at | 30 days past due |
| Plan charged off at | 120 days past due |

## Courtesy waivers per plan

A courtesy waiver here is a waiver of a late or returned-payment fee; the count is per plan in any rolling 12 months.

| Plan | Courtesy waivers in any rolling 12 months |
|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | 2 |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | 2 |

## Notes on the schedule

- A return code outside the list above, such as R07, R10 or R29, or a debit card chargeback, is not one of the codes that carry a returned-payment fee.
- The two longest plans, the 48-Month Reduced APR Plan and the 60-Month Extended Plan, allow two courtesy waivers in any rolling 12 months; all others allow one.
